WITH per_member AS (
  SELECT member_id,
         count(*) AS versions,
         sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows,
         sum(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_rows,
         sum(CASE WHEN CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_valid_today
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id
)
SELECT current_rows, open_rows, rows_valid_today, count(*) AS members
FROM per_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
